title: svc01: on_delete_cascade test fails — DELETE FROM tenant unqualified hits wrong schema
symptom: test 'svc01: on_delete_cascade removes scoped service when owner tenant deleted' asserts after.rows.len == 0 but service row survives. Failure at svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig:319.
root_cause_hypothesis: DELETE FROM tenant (unqualified) resolves to tenant_default.tenant under TestHarness search_path='tenant_default,public', while the INSERT used public.tenant explicitly. No row deleted from public.tenant, so FK cascade to public.service_catalog never fires.
confirmed_pre_existing_in: scratch/_int_test_full.log line 115862 (full integration suite run predating WF03-GH629)
discovery_context: Surfaced as incidental finding during WF03-GH629-20260809 TEST-RUNNER Step 5 after ISS-0639 svc scope fix exposed SVC tests in isolation for the first time.
resolution: Two-part fix in tests/integration/svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig: (1) DELETE FROM tenant -> DELETE FROM public.tenant to bypass TestHarness search_path=tenant_default,public. (2) SET session_replication_role = DEFAULT before DELETE to re-enable RI_FKey_cascade_del (tgenabled=O); reset to replica after. Verified: 35/35 SVC integration tests pass.
prevention: When testing FK CASCADE behavior inside TestHarness: always schema-qualify parent table references AND restore session_replication_role to DEFAULT before the triggering DELETE (TestHarness sets replica mode which disables tgenabled=O FK triggers).
